fields.Name: Up Front
fields.Description: 100% recognized when the order is booked. One-time goods and services — the booking entry credits Sales directly, with no deferral round-trip.

fields.Name: Even Over Time (Straight Line)
fields.Description: Straight-line across the line's service period — most subscriptions. A 12-month $1,200 line books to Deferred Revenue and releases 12 dated $100 entries. Rounding remainder is front-loaded into the first period.

fields.Name: All Back End (On Completion)
fields.Description: 100% recognized on the service period END date — events and milestone deliverables, where nothing is earned until delivery. Cash sits in Deferred Revenue until the event date.
